title: Finite-type subideal representatives of first cohomology
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $I$ be a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf [pqf-def-coherent]. Every $x\in H^1(X,I)$ [pqf-def-cohomology] is $H^1(X,f)(y)$ for some quasi-coherent subideal $K\subseteq I$ of finite type, some $y\in H^1(X,K)$, and an inclusion morphism $f:K\to I$ whose composite with $I\to\mathcal O_X$ is $K\to\mathcal O_X$.

source.place: Tag 01XG, first two sentences of proof, with Tags 01PG and 01FF

proof.text: The zero ideal makes the explicit subtype of finite-type subideals nonempty. Apply directedOn_ofFiniteType_le to make it a directed preorder. Obtain its ideal-module diagram, colimit cocone, and finite-type stage identifications from the algebraic diagram lemma.

Use the natural scalar-forgetting comparison at the top open in degree 1 to transport x to open-module cohomology. The compact opens are a basis by PrespectralSpace.isTopologicalBasis and the top open is compact. Apply the surjectivity clause of openModuleCohomology_directedColimit to select a stage a and class z. Naturality of the comparison inverse and its inverse identity transport z to a class w with the required image in module-valued cohomology.

Let K be a.val and let b identify D(a) with K.toModules. Use f = b.inv followed by the cocone leg, and y = H1(b.hom)(w). The stage compatibility proves the inclusion identity. Functoriality and b.hom followed by b.inv being the identity prove H1(f)(y) = x.

lean.statement:
theorem ideal_h1_finiteType_representative (X : Scheme.{u})
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (_hI : I.toModules.IsQuasicoherent)
    (x : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj I.toModules) :
    ∃ (K : X.IdealSheafData), K ≤ I ∧ K.toModules.IsFiniteType ∧
      ∃ (f : K.toModules ⟶ I.toModules)
        (y : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj K.toModules),
        f ≫ I.toModulesι = K.toModulesι ∧
          ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).map f).hom y = x
